description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/column_nonuniform_1d/rules/entraining_plume_lev: the entraining-plume op replaced by one recurrence faq over lev (seed guard at k = 1, scalar trapezoidal stencil applied at every other cell). Every binding loads fixture.esm (NLEV bound to 8 at the import edges), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST. The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise by the other bindings.
